title: At a Lebesgue point of the multiplicity, the approximate tangent plane of a containing set is a weighted approximate tangent plane
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, M, S subsets of R^(n+l), theta : R^(n+l) -> R, y in R^(n+l), P a linear subspace and eps > 0. Assume M is H^n-null-measurable, theta is a.e.-measurable for H^n restricted to M, H^n((M cap Bo_eps(y)) minus S) = 0, H^n(S cap Bo_eps(y)) < infinity, P is the approximate tangent space of S at y (Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4: Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y P), and ENNReal.ofReal (r^{-n}) * (lintegral over S cap B_r(y) of |1_M theta(w) - theta(y)|_e dH^n(w)) tends to 0 as r -> 0+, where 1_M theta = M.indicator theta. Then P is the approximate tangent space of M with respect to theta at y (Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7: Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M theta y P). Here H^n = muHE[n], Bo is the open and B the closed ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (θ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) → AEMeasurable θ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict M) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((M ∩ ball y ε) \ S) = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (S ∩ ball y ε) ≠ ⊤ → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y P → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ w in S ∩ closedBall y r, ‖M.indicator θ w - θ y‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y P
